description: Every update waits for approval in the Dependency Dashboard, and each one is checked (changelog and our usage) before merging. Security fixes skip the approval.

packageRules.description: Renovate can't read installed versions from bun.lock, so it only sees an update inside a range when it bumps the range itself.
tauri build fails when the Rust crates and the @tauri-apps packages differ in major.minor, so they move together.
Bun is pinned in 4 places in the workflows that must match, and it compiles the MCP binary we ship, so it's bumped by hand.
Tailwind v4+ is incompatible with WebKit on macOS — pinned to v3.
